title: The Final Empire
summary: On the world of Scadrial, the immortal Lord Ruler has oppressed the skaa peasant class for a thousand years under the ash-choked sky of the Final Empire. Vin, a young street urchin who can subtly influence emotions through Allomancy, is recruited by the charismatic rebel Kelsier—the Survivor of Hathsin—to join his crew of Mistings and Mistborn. Together, they plan an audacious heist against the noble houses, targeting the Lord Ruler himself. As Vin trains to master her powers and infiltrates high society, she uncovers secrets about the true nature of Allomancy, the Deepness, and the fragile balance that holds the world together.
archiveDescription: This volume documents the social and magical upheaval that marked the end of the Lord Ruler's thousand-year reign on Scadrial. The world, shaped by constant ashfall and volcanic winter, had been governed under a rigid caste system sustained by the manipulation of metal-born investiture. The narrative follows the formation of a revolutionary conspiracy among the skaa underclass and the rediscovery of Allomancy's full potential as a tool of insurrection. The account provides essential context for understanding Scadrial's political transformation and the cosmic forces that would later emerge from this conflict.
